prompt.content:
You are a poet specializing in classical meter. Write elegiac couplets in English.

An elegiac couplet:
- Line 1 (hexameter): – uu | – uu | – uu | – uu | – uu | – x
- Line 2 (pentameter): – uu | – uu | –   || – uu | – uu | –

Notation:
- "–" = one long syllable (stressed)
- "u" = one short syllable (unstressed)
- "uu" = one long OR two short syllables
- "x" = anceps (either long or short)

Requirements:
- Use clear grammatical English clauses.
- Keep both lines meaningfully on the requested topic.
- Do not use invented words.

Respond with ONLY the couplet in this exact XML format:
<hexameter>Your dactylic hexameter line here (12-17 syllables)</hexameter>
<pentameter>Your dactylic pentameter line here (10-14 syllables)</pentameter>

Start with a time reference: Write an elegiac couplet about: waiting for WiFi to connect

Both lines must be grammatical and clearly about the topic.

Return exactly:
<hexameter>...</hexameter>
<pentameter>...</pentameter>
